question: Who among the following is the first Indian woman cricketer to play 200 One Day International (ODI) matches?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Mithali Raj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mithali Raj was born on **3 December 1982**, in **Jodhpur** district,** Rajasthan**.

 
 
• She is the **1st Indian woman** cricketer to play **200 One Day** International Matches.
 
• She is also the **1st and only woman** cricketer to participate in the** 6 world cup**.
 
• She is the** all-time leading run-scorer for India** in** Test, ODI, and T20. As of August 2022.**
 
• She has received many awards for her contribution and performance in cricket.
 
 
• **Wisden Leading Woman Cricketer in the World in 2017, Arjuna Award in 2003, the Padma Shri in 2015, and Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna in 2021**.
 
 
 
• She has taken** retirement** from all forms of cricket in **June** **2022**.
